Title: Azure Monitor Dynamic Threshold meter name change

Body.Content:
Effective July 1, 2019, the meter name for Dynamic Threshold feature in Azure Monitor will change. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on the name.

See the table below for name change details.

Meter ID (Resource GUID)

Service Name

Old Service Type

New Service Type

Old Resource Name

New Resource Name

Old Product name (EA Portal Name)

New Product name (EA Portal Name)
